name: 911 Linear Inches
description: Reads a batch's nest DXFs and package PDFs and computes the linear inches of cut per part, per nest, and per batch, exported to an Excel report.
author: Anthony Sieben

fields.label: Default IGES/Batch Folder
fields.description: Optional folder the picker opens to. Pick the batch's 'IGES FILES' folder (or the batch folder itself) at run time.
